Download the official app to complete your visit to this exhibition produced by the Palais Galliera and presented at the Kimbell Art Museum from October 7, 2018, to January 6, 2019.

Through audio and text descriptions of a selection of 18 essential pieces by the fashion designer, an offstage video, and a lexicon, discover the unique style and approach of Balenciaga and learn everything about the technical vocabulary of haute couture.
